description: Automatic tunnel recovery with exponential backoff and circuit breaker

requirements.title: Trigger on ready endpoint failure
requirements.description: When cloudflared's /ready endpoint returns non-200 for N consecutive checks (configurable, default 3), initiate recovery. Single transient failures should not trigger recovery.

requirements.title: Consecutive failure threshold
requirements.description: Recovery only triggers after N consecutive failures (configurable, default 3) to prevent false positives from transient errors

requirements.title: Failure counter reset on success
requirements.description: Consecutive failure counter resets to zero when a successful ready check is observed

requirements.title: Ready endpoint polling
requirements.description: Poll cloudflared /ready endpoint at configurable interval to detect failures

requirements.title: Trigger on HA connection loss
requirements.description: When cloudflared_tunnel_ha_connections drops to 0 and stays at 0 for 2 consecutive metric scrapes, initiate recovery.

requirements.title: Recovery action: systemctl restart
requirements.description: Primary recovery action is 'sudo systemctl restart cloudflared'. After restart, poll /ready endpoint until 200 or timeout (30s).

requirements.title: Systemctl restart invocation
requirements.description: Execute 'sudo systemctl restart cloudflared' as the primary recovery action

requirements.title: Post-restart readiness verification
requirements.description: After restart, poll /ready endpoint until 200 or timeout (30s) to confirm recovery succeeded

requirements.title: Exponential backoff
requirements.description: If recovery fails, retry with exponential backoff: 30s, 1m, 2m, 4m, 8m, capped at 15m. Reset backoff after a successful recovery.

requirements.title: Backoff interval progression
requirements.description: Retry intervals double with each attempt: 30s, 1m, 2m, 4m, 8m, capped at 15m maximum

requirements.title: Backoff reset on success
requirements.description: After a successful recovery, reset backoff level to initial value (30s)

requirements.title: Circuit breaker
requirements.description: After 5 consecutive failed recovery attempts, enter circuit-open state: stop automatic recovery, log critical alert. Circuit resets after configurable cooldown (default 1h) or manual reset via CLI/API.

requirements.title: Circuit open on threshold
requirements.description: After 5 consecutive failed recoveries, transition to circuit-open state and stop automatic recovery

requirements.title: Critical alert on circuit open
requirements.description: Log a critical-level alert when circuit breaker opens to signal manual intervention needed

requirements.title: Circuit reset mechanisms
requirements.description: Circuit resets after configurable cooldown (default 1h) or via manual reset through CLI/API

requirements.title: Recovery event persistence
requirements.description: Log every recovery attempt to the database: timestamp, trigger reason, action taken, outcome (success/failure), duration, backoff level. Retain 30 days of history.

requirements.title: Recovery event schema
requirements.description: Each recovery event stores timestamp, trigger reason, action taken, outcome, duration, and backoff level

requirements.title: History retention policy
requirements.description: Automatically purge recovery event records older than 30 days

requirements.title: Manual recovery via CLI/API
requirements.description: 'tunnel-manager recover' triggers an immediate recovery attempt, bypassing backoff (but not circuit breaker unless --force is used). Returns result.
